crossRefs.note: They lived in Gilead in Bashan, and in its towns, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon, as far as their borders.
Sharon will be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down in, for my people who have…

translations.web: and over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite; and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai;
translations.bsb: Shitrai the Sharonite was in charge of the herds grazing in Sharon. Shaphat son of Adlai was in charge of the herds in the valleys.
